courses.note: The Fall 2026 major requires no AI or machine learning course. CS 470 Artificial Intelligence is an elective (Elective A list) and is the undergraduate introduction to AI; CS 270 Intro to ML is an elective in the B group. Only BYU learning-outcomes pages were found, no course syllabus or course website for CS 470 or CS 270. The department AI Use Levels page (cs.byu.edu/department/ai-policy) applies to all CS courses but is not a course syllabus.

notes: Core courses from the Fall 2026 requirements flowchart: CS 111, 191, 224, 235, 236, 240, 252, 260, 291, 312, 324, 340, 404. The department publishes AI Use Levels (0 to 4) at cs.byu.edu/department/ai-policy, and course syllabi set a default level, so the course layer here depends on that department document (collected separately in the institution layer if at all).
